queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene})-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(v:Variant)-[:IN_MOLECULAR_PROFILE]->(mp:MolecularProfile) RETURN DISTINCT mp.name AS molecular_profile, mp.molecular_profile_id AS molecular_profile_id, v.variant_name AS variant ORDER BY molecular_profile, variant
queries.name: profiles_by_gene

queries.cypher: MATCH (mp:MolecularProfile) WHERE toUpper(mp.name) CONTAINS $variant_upper RETURN DISTINCT mp.name AS molecular_profile, mp.molecular_profile_id AS molecular_profile_id ORDER BY molecular_profile
queries.name: profiles_containing_l858r

queries.cypher: MATCH (mp:MolecularProfile) WHERE toUpper(mp.name) CONTAINS $variant_upper RETURN DISTINCT mp.name AS molecular_profile, mp.molecular_profile_id AS molecular_profile_id ORDER BY molecular_profile
queries.name: profiles_containing_t790m

queries.cypher: MATCH (mp:MolecularProfile)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence) WHERE toUpper(mp.name) CONTAINS $variant_upper OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:TARGETS_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN mp.name AS molecular_profile, mp.molecular_profile_id AS molecular_profile_id, e.evidence_id AS evidence_id, e.significance AS significance, e.evidence_direction AS evidence_direction, e.evidence_level AS evidence_level, e.evidence_type AS evidence_type, e.disease AS disease, e.citation_id AS citation_id, e.evidence_statement AS evidence_statement, e.source_type AS source_type, d.drug_name AS drug ORDER BY evidence_id, drug
queries.name: evidence_containing_l858r

queries.cypher: MATCH (mp:MolecularProfile)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence)-[:TARGETS_DRUG]->(d:Drug) WHERE toLower(d.drug_name) IN $drug_names RETURN mp.name AS molecular_profile, e.evidence_id AS evidence_id, e.significance AS significance, e.evidence_direction AS evidence_direction, e.disease AS disease, e.citation_id AS citation_id, e.evidence_statement AS evidence_statement, d.drug_name AS drug ORDER BY evidence_id
queries.name: evidence_for_osimertinib

queries.cypher: MATCH (e:Evidence) WHERE any(c IN e.citation_id WHERE c IN $pmid_strings) OPTIONAL MATCH (mp:MolecularProfile)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:TARGETS_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN mp.name AS molecular_profile, e.evidence_id AS evidence_id, e.significance AS significance, e.evidence_direction AS evidence_direction, e.disease AS disease, e.citation_id AS citation_id, e.evidence_statement AS evidence_statement, d.drug_name AS drug ORDER BY evidence_id, drug
queries.name: evidence_citing_expected_pmids

queries.cypher: MATCH (d:Drug) WHERE toLower(d.drug_name) IN $drug_names RETURN d.drug_name AS drug_name, d.concept_id AS concept_id, d.approved AS approved ORDER BY drug_name
queries.name: expected_drugs_present

queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Publication) WHERE p.pmid IN $pmids RETURN p.pmid AS pmid, p.citation_text AS citation_text, p.year AS year, p.source_type AS source_type ORDER BY pmid
queries.name: expected_publications

queries.cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial) WHERE t.nct_id IN $nct_ids RETURN t.nct_id AS nct_id, t.title AS title, t.phase AS phase, t.status AS status, t.conditions AS conditions ORDER BY nct_id
queries.name: expected_trials

queries.cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:ASSOCIATED_GENE]->(g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene}) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:TESTS_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN t.nct_id AS nct_id, t.title AS title, t.phase AS phase, t.status AS status, collect(DISTINCT d.drug_name) AS drugs ORDER BY nct_id
queries.name: trials_by_gene
